text:
emily: opened a PR to fix quota docs + add a small rate-limit example + migration note for old headers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1422

raj: nice. can you add a tiny curl + python example for sending meter events? most tickets are from bad header shape.

emily: sure. curl snippet will show X-Redwood-Meter format. python will use requests.

tia: also include a 1-row CSV example and a note on timestamps must be ISO8601 UTC. timezone confuses people.

emily: added CSV row in PR description: `2026-03-10T00:00:00Z,tenant_a,generation,1024`

raj: small UX nit: rename table column "unit" -> "billing_unit" and mention tokens vs requests in a footnote.

emily: done. added footnote and brief mapping: tokens=billing unit for generation APIs.

infra-bot: preview build started for PR #1422 (lint, linkcheck).

emily: including PromQL for the dashboard aggregate: `sum(increase(redwood_meter_tokens_total[1h])) by (tenant)`

tia: add migration blurb: older SDKs used `X-Redwood-Quota` header; include a one-liner converter script.

emily: added converter and a link to migration guide. docs-bot: preview available https://deploy-preview-1422--docs.redwood.ai/

raj: LGTM after preview check. thanks for keeping it compact.

emily: merging once checks pass, will follow up with localized snippets.

docs-bot: PR #1422 merged by emily. release note: "docs(quota): add examples, clarify billing_unit, migration note"
